results.snippet: It examines the specific reading operation Lukács provides—a materialist reading of Presocratic philosophy that Lukács calls an “energetic reinterpretation”—and how this reading neither relativizes nor historicizes the Presocratics. In his remarkably perspicuous interpretation, Lukács reads his present through the lens of the Presocratics while also offering a materialist interpretation of Presocratic philosophy.
